title: Lester joins in on I Got Rhythm and tears it apart
summary: After a hundred choruses from the others, Lester entered after Chester Brown and played everything in I Got Rhythm.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: So that was Paul, Toby, Walter Page and then Chester.
Well, after they all played about a hundred choruses, I'd say, then... Who stopped playing? I think Chester, after he ended his chorus, that's when Prez fell in.

He ended his solo. And Prez fell in. Man, if they got through with "I Got Rhythm," it wasn't no more. They tore it all to pieces. Prez ripped it. When he went through it, he played everything in it. He could bet anybody, anyway, said he could play a hundred choruses and play them different. We knew that. He used to tell us that.
